page.title: Activity & audit
page.subtitle: Operational feed and immutable audit trail for security and compliance.

chain.help: Each device chains the audit events it writes; a changed, removed or inserted event breaks the chain.
chain.unchained_one: {{count}} older event was written before chaining existed and is not covered.
chain.unchained_other: {{count}} older events were written before chaining existed and are not covered.

problem.prev_mismatch: the chain is relinked at position {{seq}} (event #{{id}}): an event before it was removed or replaced
problem.missing_positions: positions before {{seq}} are missing (event #{{id}}): removed, or not received from that device yet
